We were officiallty notified that the Mark House,
possibly the oldest extant farmhouse in the Town
of Colonie, was added to the National Register of
Historic Places as of August 29th, 2022. This Rev-
olutionary War Soldier and Van Rensselaer tenant
farmer’s house is now on both the New York State
and National Registers of Historic Places. More
information to follow.
